summary: Zhibao Technology Inc. (NASDAQ: ZBAO) filed a Form 6-K disclosing a September 28, 2026 Merger and Acquisition Agreement to acquire 100% of NEXSYS TECH SDN. BHD., a newly incorporated Malaysian shell, from sole shareholder Choi Sai Wai. Consideration is $1 cash at closing plus up to $7.5 million in contingent earn-out payable solely in Class A ordinary shares, contingent on $3.015 million cumulative audited net profit over a 27-month term against a $201 million revenue reference. Closing is subject to customary conditions; no advisor or board recommendation named. Watch earn-out achievability given NEXSYS has no operating history and only preliminary 26MW data-center arrangements in East Malaysia and Indonesia.
